interaction.model_cot: Delegated to backend-rust subagent on feature/phase-2-T-2.2.1 (off feature/phase-2-T-2.1.1). Key design choice worth remembering: MountId ended up as a self-describing Root{scheme,authority}/Nested{scheme,parent:Arc<VPath>} rather than a bare integer handle, because §9.1's VPath sketch demands Display/FromStr round-tripping without a live mount table to resolve an opaque id against — an opaque MountId would make VPath::to_string()/parse() lossy or require threading a registry through parsing. Also added hand-rolled percent-encoding (pct.rs) so real filenames/hosts containing !, %, :, @ don't collide with the path grammar's own separators when nesting (zip:zip:file://...!/...!/...).
